description: This file defines semantic conventions for OpenTelemetry attributes related to feature flags, message events, and exceptions, including constants and helper functions for attribute key-value creation.

methods.name: FeatureFlagKey
methods.description: Returns an attribute key-value pair for the feature flag key.

methods.name: FeatureFlagProviderName
methods.description: Returns an attribute key-value pair for the feature flag provider name.

methods.name: FeatureFlagVariant
methods.description: Returns an attribute key-value pair for the feature flag variant.

methods.name: MessageID
methods.description: Returns an attribute key-value pair for message ID, given an integer.

methods.name: MessageCompressedSize
methods.description: Returns an attribute key-value pair for message compressed size, given an integer.

methods.name: MessageUncompressedSize
methods.description: Returns an attribute key-value pair for message uncompressed size, given an integer.

methods.name: ExceptionEscaped
methods.description: Returns an attribute key-value pair indicating if an exception has escaped, given a boolean.
